land.text: the British colony of Seychelles (a separate crown colony from Mauritius since 1903) and, from 23 June 1976, Aldabra, Farquhar and Desroches, held by the British Indian Ocean Territory since 1965

predecessors.note: Cliopatria's UK row is 'Kingdom of Great Britain' 1709-2024.

capitals.name: Victoria
capitals.note: 'Eight of the districts make up the capital of Seychelles and are referred to as Greater Victoria'; the page does not say outright that Victoria is on Mahé.

correction.text: the 115 islands of the archipelago, Mahé and the outer islands, including Aldabra, Farquhar and Desroches returned on 23 June 1976

keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's shape (259 km2, bbox 55.21-55.43 E, 4.79-4.60 S) lies about 0.1 degree west of Mahé and resolves to no land cell in the gazetteer; the country as Natural Earth draws it resolves to 1 cell at Mahé. The infobox gives 457 km2 (ratio 0.57, inside a factor of two) and 'an archipelagic country consisting of 115 islands'. At this grid the outer islands (Aldabra, Farquhar and Desroches per the BIOT page) cannot appear as cells: a rendering agent may draw them as symbols.

correction.text: the 115 islands of the archipelago, Mahé and the outer islands, including Aldabra, Farquhar and Desroches returned on 23 June 1976

keyframe_review.note: Identical to the 1976 shape and misplaced in the same way.

ledger.note: 1976: Seychelles becomes independent from the United Kingdom as a republic. Infobox 'Independence declared: 29 June 1976'; 'In 1976, Seychelles gained independence from the United Kingdom as a republic.' The first president was James Mancham.

region.text: Aldabra, Farquhar and Desroches, detached to the British Indian Ocean Territory in 1965 and returned on 23 June 1976

ledger.note: 1976: Aldabra, Farquhar and Desroches return to Seychelles. 'On 23 June 1976, these islands were returned to the Seychelles, which became independent as a republic on 29 June 1976'; the UK had taken 'the islands of Aldabra, Farquhar, and Desroches (Des Roches) from the Seychelles' into the British Indian Ocean Territory, established 8 November 1965. The Seychelles page is silent on the transfer. The page names three islands; the region (the Outer Islands) is the researcher's wider reading.

certainty.note: An island state: coast and outer islands. Reclaimed islands made after the constitution (no date on the page) and the 2015 lease of Assumption Island to India are not border changes.

sources.note: Detachment of Aldabra, Farquhar and Desroches into BIOT on 8 November 1965 and their return to Seychelles on 23 June 1976.

notes: Cliopatria's Seychelles shape (both rows) is drawn 0.1 degree west of Mahé and holds no land cell: both are adjusted to the Natural Earth country polygon. The gazetteer grid resolves the country to a single cell at Mahé; the outer islands are lost at this resolution. The names Aldabra, Farquhar (Group) and Desroches are not in the gazetteer's places: listed for the gazetteer agent. The BIOT page dates the return to 23 June 1976 and independence to 29 June (the Seychelles page infobox gives 29 June); the BIOT is a UK territory, so the counterpart is the Kingdom of Great Britain row (no BIOT dossier exists; a British Indian Ocean Territory dossier 1965-2024 would be a direct counterpart for Mauritius too). The Seychelles page dates the 1977 coup to 5 June 1977 and gives the one-party state as lasting until 1991 in one passage and until 1993 in another; neither moved a border.
